title: MCP server
intro: AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop or any MCP client) can read the state of DevDock and start npm scripts. The server only answers on this computer and requires the token.
tokenHint: The token is stored next to config.json (.devdock-mcp-token) and is not exported. Regenerating it disconnects the clients configured with the old one.
claudeDesktopHint: In claude_desktop_config.json (needs Node.js: mcp-remote connects the client to the HTTP server):
otherClients: Other clients: Streamable HTTP transport to the endpoint above, with the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
toolsHint: Database tools only work while the vault is unlocked from this UI: the agent never receives nor enters the master password.
confirmRegenerate: Regenerate the token? Clients configured with the current one will stop working.
regenerated: Token regenerated: update the clients' configuration
